standard: ASME B30.26 (rigging hardware); dimensions from the Crosby Blocks catalogue p.326
description: Single-sheave snatch block with shackle fitting, 2-12 t: two side plates with the near one swinging open about the centre pin, a grooved sheave on a bronze bushing or roller bearing, the headed centre pin, a swivel yoke, and an anchor shackle bow with its pin. Thirteen catalogue rows drive two independent ladders - the sheave is sized by wire rope diameter, the fitting by working load limit - and the published overall height A is reproduced exactly by the B/2 + D + E stack rather than tabulated.
source: Crosby Blocks catalogue p.326 metric size table (https://kitocrosby.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/15_Blocks_MET_326.pdf); groove profile and unpublished fitting proportions documented in NOTES.md
